developer.name: Alien Arena team - previously COR Entertainment

description.p: Do you like old school deathmatch with modern features? How about rich, colorful, arcade-like atmospheres? How about...retro Sci Fi? Then you're going to love what Alien Arena has in store for you! This game combines some of the very best aspects of such games as Quake III and Unreal Tournament and wraps them up with a retro alien theme, while adding tons of original ideas to make the game quite unique.

Release 7.72 and later has been optimized to smoothly run at least a 100 FPS frame rate on a 100-tick server with 100 PPS packet rate, and with a mouse polling rate that aligns with the frame rate. This greatly improves the smoothness and responsiveness of the game. Also the lag compensation got an improvement to match the 100-tick server better and to make it fairer to low-ping players, which is configurable per server.
Also from 7.72 and later you can now practice the game modes CTF and Tactical from the single player menu, for Deathmatch and CTF you can now also choose weapon modes Insta and Insta/Rockets.
Note about the "Potentially unsafe" warning: This game uses the xorg legacy windowing system, and allows the use of a joystick or controller.
To find people to play with or if you are having issues please join us on Discord, Matrix or IRC, see alienarena.org.
Join our daily CTF matches on the AAOCS server! These are usually between 19:00 UTC and 23:00 UTC.

ul.li: Fixed stuttering issue at 60 FPS
Fixed bot firing rate at high tick rates

Project 100: optimized the game to support at least 100 FPS framerate, 100 FPS server tickrate, 100 PPS packet rate, and mouse polling rate that aligns with the framerate, this greatly improves the smoothness and responsiveness of the game
Extended single player mode with more game modes and weapon modes, CTF and Tactical (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1185375745), Insta and Insta/Rockets
Added fairer antilag calculation based on one-way ping with server-side configuration options and diminishing effect on very high pings
Optimized mouse movement logic (this is under cvar m_direct, recommended to set m_direct to 1)
Added centered message about who killed you
Drop old particles if the particle buffer is full
Check ragdoll buffer before creating new ragdolls
Fixed bug with crashing clients when lots of rockets were fired
Fixed bug with duplicate ragdolls
Fixed bug with ragdolls hanging in mid air
Fixed bug with disappearing flag in CTF mode when people quit the match or disconnected
Added command teamselect to the list of available commands
Automatic and ultra-fast installation of map packs before loading a map (by default enabled)
Fixed a bug in single player mode that caused crashes with bot interaction
Added Discord button in the main menu to easily join the Discord server
Fixed a map difference error bug after reinstalling a map
Added option to override the sky from the fog script (only relevant to mappers)
Removed the sponsor banner
Increased default time that messages appear in the screen to 6 seconds and can be changed and remembered now
There is now a filter in the server list to show active servers only
It's easier to see the number of real players in the server list
The server list sorts on player count, ping by default
The newsfeed can show colors now
The antilag has been optimized for extra smooth gameplay
The explosion and pain distortion effects are now off by default
